thread:
acme_dev: Hey, trial account showing 0 credits used after running a bulk embeddings job (curl to /v1/embeddings). Response looks normal but balance still 500 credits. Can share request id if helpful.

alex_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the request_id and a minimal curl you used? Also which api_key/org are you on?

acme_dev: request_id=rs_20240428_9f3a2c, curl below:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test-acme" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-small","input":["a","b","c"]}'
```
Org visible in header is `acme-org` — using trial account from signup.

alex_support: Got it. I pulled the request from our logs: ingress shows the request, model executed, embeddings returned, but billing ledger shows no debit events for rs_20240428_9f3a2c. Tagging @jess_engineer to help triage routing/billing glue.

jess_engineer: Looking now — I can see the request hit ingress node ingress-3, and the request carried an extra header: `X-Org-Alias: acme-test`. That header caused routing to a tenant alias we use for internal trial routing that has a separate billing namespace. Ledger lookup keyed on canonical_org_id, but routing sometimes resolves aliases late. If the alias wasn't resolved before billing hook, the billing call used an empty org_id and got treated as internal/no-charge.

acme_dev: Huh — we didn't set that header explicitly. Our internal proxy adds `X-Org-Alias` for multi-tenant forwarding.

alex_support: Thanks, that explains it. Quick workaround: remove/strip `X-Org-Alias` header or set the canonical org header `X-Org-Id: acme-org-id-123` with your requests. That should ensure billing associates properly.

mike_billing: Confirming from ledger side: the requests show up with request_id rs_20240428_9f3a2c but org_id blank, so they never debited the trial bucket. We can retro-debit once we confirm totals with the customer, or issue promo credit if desired.

jess_engineer: We'll push a fix to ensure alias resolution happens earlier in the request pipeline so billing always gets canonical_org_id. Temporary PR: set canonical id in ingress headers before billing hook. I'll coordinate with eng-infra.

acme_dev: Appreciate that. For now can you apply the expected debit to my trial so dashboard reflects usage? I ran ~3 inputs ~ 3 tokens each — rough estimate 9 token-equivalents.

mike_billing: I can apply a manual debit of 9 units to acme-org-id-123 after you confirm final numbers. Can you confirm the number of texts/characters?

acme_dev: Confirmed 3 texts, small ones. Fine to apply 9. Thanks.

alex_support: Done — mike, please proceed when ready. Jess, any ETA on patch?

jess_engineer: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4123 — short patch in ingress to resolve alias earlier. Deploy to staging today, can roll to production in next maintenance window (w/in 24h).

mike_billing: Manual debit applied and updated ledger. acme_dev, you should see balance drop now. Let us know if anything looks off.

acme_dev: Balance updated, thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick help. :tada:

alex_support: Reactions: :thumbsup: — marking this resolved but keeping an eye on the rollout. If anyone else hits weird zero-debit cases, please ping `#support` with request_id.

ingress-bot: deploy staged: ingress/resolve-alias-before-billing -> staging successful

jess_engineer: Will post follow-up after prod rollout.

acme_dev: Thanks — closing from our side.
